target.rawSql: SELECT detected_at AS time, metric_name || ' (' || algorithm || ', score=' || round(score::numeric, 2) || ')' AS text FROM anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) ORDER BY detected_at

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS "time", CASE WHEN created_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE paid_count::float8 / created_count END AS "conversion_rate" FROM metrics_windows WHERE window_size_seconds = $window_size_seconds AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start

SELECT window_start AS "time", CASE WHEN created_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cancelled_expired_count::float8 / created_count END AS "expired", CASE WHEN created_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cancelled_payment_failed_count::float8 / created_count END AS "payment_failed", CASE WHEN created_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cancelled_user_cancelled_count::float8 / created_count END AS "user_cancelled" FROM metrics_windows WHERE window_size_seconds = $window_size_seconds AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start
SELECT error_message, sum(error_count) AS count FROM payment_error_profile WHERE window_size_seconds = $window_size_seconds AND $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY error_message ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT detected_at AS "time", metric_name, algorithm, approach, window_start, score FROM anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) ORDER BY detected_at DESC

SELECT window_start, created_count, paid_count, cancelled_expired_count, cancelled_payment_failed_count, cancelled_user_cancelled_count FROM metrics_windows WHERE window_size_seconds = $window_size_seconds ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 1
